name: Raj
bio: 34, backend engineer, has played Structs on testnet for a year, runs a small guild. Knows raids, ambits, charge, PDC and stealth bombers by heart. Curious whether this skin can win over his non-gamer partner, and suspicious it hides depth.
goals: Map every restaurant concept back to Structs and check it is faithful
Run a raid (service challenge) and win it
Find where the skin lies or oversimplifies
readingStyle: Reads everything, including tooltips and the glossary. Notices numbers that do not add up.
skills: Expert mouse/keyboard, hovers for tooltips, checks Settings early.
researchQuestions: Is the mapping consistent everywhere (HUD, sheets, logs, glossary)?
Can an expert execute a deliberate raid strategy (ambit targeting, covers, stealth) through this UI?
Is anything missing that a Structs player would expect (fleet movement, charge visibility, raid timer)?
Would he recommend it to his non-gamer partner?
quirks: Says 'so this is the PDC' out loud
Tests the Manager move between areas
Tries a raid against the strongest rival
